description: This file implements back-end APIs for DHCPv6 configuration and management. It includes functions for initializing DHCPv6, managing server pools, options, clients, and handling messages related to DHCPv6 in a platform-independent way. The file contains extensive code for Utopia configuration, thread management, and platform-specific handling for various devices and systems.
